summary: Detailed implementation plan for three FaceSwap pipeline improvements: Phase-weighted progress bar (faceswap.py threading + ffprobe), rolling-average ETA in the worker status JSON (fs_worker.py), and frame-level resume/checkpoint with smart re-queue on failure (both faceswap.py and fs_worker.py). Includes exact file paths, line-level context, and code snippets for every change.
